guardrails.title: 一次操作，要过四道护栏
guardrails.lead: 这不是安全口号。下面这台终端在跑真实命令，四道护栏随执行依次点亮。

steps.title: 密钥不进 argv
steps.body: 密码只从 stdin、隐藏输入或受控环境变量进入。

steps.title: 输出默认脱敏
steps.body: 密码、TOTP、卡号和私钥在普通输出中保持遮蔽。

steps.title: 写操作先预演
steps.body: 没有显式 --apply，管理命令只返回计划。

steps.title: 删除默认可恢复
steps.body: 普通删除进入回收站，永久清除需要额外确认。

dry.text: ✓ decrypted locally / secrets never enter argv
Dry run: 3 duplicate groups, 5 items would be soft-deleted.

apply.text: ✓ Soft-deleted 5 duplicate items. Recoverable from trash.

cli.title: Web 管理，CLI 执行
cli.lead: 同一套加密实现服务浏览器和命令行，Agent 得到机器可读结果，你保留明确的披露边界。
cli.playgroundHint: 点击命令组，查看真实 --help 输出

auth: status    Show session info (never prints secrets)
vault: sync      Pull the latest vault from the server
get       Show one entry in full (redacted unless --reveal)
analyze: health      Weak / empty / reused / stale passwords
manage: trash     list | restore | purge  (purge is irreversible)
credential: list      List aliases and metadata (never returns secrets)
set       Create or update an alias (secret via stdin/prompt/env)

meta.title: Bitwardenagents | Safe Bitwarden work for agents
meta.description: Constrain agent vault operations with redaction, dry runs, recoverable deletion, and local decryption.

hero.eyebrow: A Bitwarden tool built for agents
hero.title: Agents organize. Plaintext stays local.
hero.lead: Redacted by default. Preview first, confirm second. Delegate duplicates, health checks, and infrastructure credentials while keeping control.
hero.visualNote: Synthetic data · no real account connection

heroWindow.scanReady: Preview ready · waiting for your confirmation

vaultBridge.title: One vault for you and your agents
vaultBridge.lead: Logins, cards, identities, secure notes, and SSH keys stay in Bitwarden. Bitwardenagents adds self-hosted Web, Docker, and CLI access without scattered copies.
vaultBridge.localNote: Original data stays in Bitwarden. Agents receive redacted output by default.
vaultBridge.stageHint: Choose an item and an interface, then run the secure route

guardrails.title: Every operation passes four gates
guardrails.lead: Not a slogan. The terminal below runs a real command; the gates light up as it executes.

steps.title: Secrets stay out of argv
steps.body: Passwords enter through stdin, hidden prompts, or controlled environment variables.

steps.title: Output is redacted
steps.body: Passwords, TOTP codes, card numbers, and private keys stay masked.

steps.title: Writes preview first
steps.body: Without explicit --apply, management commands return a plan only.

steps.title: Deletion is recoverable
steps.body: Normal deletion moves items to trash. Purging needs extra confirmation.

dry.text: ✓ decrypted locally / secrets never enter argv
Dry run: 3 duplicate groups, 5 items would be soft-deleted.

apply.text: ✓ Soft-deleted 5 duplicate items. Recoverable from trash.

cli.title: Manage in Web. Execute in CLI.
cli.lead: One encryption implementation serves the browser and command line. Agents get machine-readable results while disclosure stays explicit.

manage: trash     list | restore | purge  (purge is irreversible)
credential: list      List aliases and metadata (never returns secrets)

items.title: Health priorities
items.body: Find weak, reused, stale, and incomplete credentials.

items.title: Duplicate cleanup
items.body: Review differences before choosing a recoverable cleanup path.

items.title: Stable credential aliases
items.body: Agents address service credentials by name instead of repeated copy and paste.

securityReport.title: Publish the findings before the finish line.
securityReport.lead: We reviewed the source, container, and NAS surface through OWASP WSTG/ASVS and the CIS Docker Benchmark. The fixes are deployed to the NAS and passed the production checks.
securityReport.note: No real secrets were read or displayed, and no production write operation was executed.

findings.title: Session writes now require same-origin requests
HTTP and container hardening are live
PIN KDF and rate limiting are live

boundary.title: Plaintext stops locally
boundary.lead: The browser derives keys and decrypts the vault. The proxy forwards Bitwarden requests and does not store vault plaintext.
boundary.note: The source and agent skill remain independently inspectable.

final.title: Delegate the cleanup. Keep plaintext local.

footer.privacy: No analytics scripts. No advertising trackers.
